svg.title: Last Call — revised casino floor
svg.desc: Measured top-down plan, north up. Fifty by 31.67 metres. Rooms, walls, door openings, games, seats and principal routes are drawn from the game map.
svg.text: THE FLOOR HAS A CLEAR ORDER
1 One derby pedestal; doorway and spectator side stay open.
2 Race board sits on solid wall, clear of the arcade doorway.
3 40 penny slots in four concealing banks; high-limit slots in VIP.
4 Roulette and dice share the southern table pit; VIP entry is clear.
5 Flying Pigs joins the arcade; north-south promenade stays clear.
Cream dots: player positions · Mint gaps: doors · Green strips: measured aisles · Palm rings: full spread · Purple: staff passages · T: trashcans
Actual game coordinates · furniture footprints · north up · 60 simulation pixels = 1 metre
